command: pre-registration: R2a null-field modes + instruction/null ratio, H1-H3, after readout validation, before modes

metrics.H1: coverage of the named object by the null-field options, pooled over the 22 object-role tasks (episode means, task-cluster bootstrap) >= 0.8 (estimate gate)
metrics.H2: zs wrong_object episodes: ratio_top > policy_sample; one-sided exact sign test on discordant episodes; < 10 episodes -> not testable
metrics.H3: zs successful object-role episodes: ratio_top - policy_sample >= -0.05; one-sided bootstrap p (share <= -0.05)
metrics.comparators: policy_sample, policy_exec, instr_lik_top, instr_mode_top, cag_mode_top, null_mass_top, random
metrics.disclosure: seen before this row: the zs rollouts of 28 of 29 tasks (libero_90:16 still rolling; its observations join the mode stage when it finishes) and their episode types (validation episode_types); the readout validation on 28 tasks; a hand check of libero_90:14 trial 13 (printed geometry), which showed max-cosine picking the cabinet BEHIND the plate, so the readout gained the first-along-heading rule (5 cm corridor) before the validation aggregate; a 2-observation GPU smoke of the mode stage (results/r2a/scratch/smoke_modes, post-grasp observations of libero_90:14, never read as data): it showed 63 s per observation and 46 of 48 null starts in one cluster, after which only the null modes and drafts are scored and the post-grasp role keeps 1 observation per episode; no pre-grasp mode, no ratio of a pre-grasp observation and no arm aggregate was computed
metrics.estimator: Delta = L_FM(a|o,null) - L_FM(a|o,instr), velocity loss, t 0.1..0.9 uniform, K 8 shared noises (seed 5); Diffusion-Classifier ELBO difference
metrics.family: Holm over H2-H3 at alpha 0.05; H1 an estimate gate; closed loop only if H1 and H2 pass
metrics.modes: null field; 12 null drafts x u {0.1, 0.3, 0.55} + 12 x 0.7 eps at u 0.7; Adam 80 it lr 0.02; Tweedie x0; greedy rms 0.15 clusters; option score = mean member Delta; also instr and CAG (w 2) fields from the same starts
metrics.readout: 10-step path integrated with the pp2_dev_l90c scale; argmax horizontal cosine over candidates; < 2 cm -> none; cluster object = member majority
metrics.secondary: every arm by bin / kind / scene / instance / zs type; goal role (post-grasp) tables; eps-weighted ratio; wrong-object cards
metrics.written_before: any mode, likelihood ratio or arm aggregate
